summary: Claude invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, treated the "add preferences storage" brief as a new subsystem (architectural path), ran a multi-question design dialogue, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md, presented it for review before any code, and only after approval moved on to hyperpowers:writing-plans.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria were satisfied and verified against both the screen transcript and on-disk artifacts/session log.

observations.description: Spec review gate via Codex returned nothing usable: 'Each returned an empty JSON payload {} with exit 0 ... verdict-normalize --require-coverage returned {"result":"incomplete","reason":"json payload has no terminal verdict"}'. Agent reported runtime 'codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub' and 'this spec has had no independent Codex review at any stage.' Expected for a stub, but the review gate silently degrades to incomplete.

The agent asked for approval at three separate checkpoints (mid-design architecture check, pre-spec design summary, then the spec itself), so the tester had to say 'looks good, go ahead' three times before implementation began.
Agent wrote a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers and docs/superpowers 'per your standing rule' — an unrequested repo change made during the brainstorming phase, before approval of implementation.

criteria.evidence: grep of session jsonl: "name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} appears before "hyperpowers:writing-plans".

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote a spec doc to docs/*/specs/
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'this ... adds a new subsystem rather than changing an existing flow, so I'll run the full process: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, and a written spec before any code.' File exists: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md (ls output), containing '# User Preferences Storage — Design'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md ... Please review it and tell me if you want changes.' git status --short in workdir showed only '?? .gitignore' — no new source/test files.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Agent explicitly offered to collapse to a short in-chat design only if asked ('Say the word if you'd rather I collapse that to a short in-chat design') and instead wrote the committed spec file on disk.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No throwaway probe plan appeared; the flow went design dialogue → spec doc → writing-plans skill ('Handing off to the writing-plans skill to turn it into an implementation plan').
